items.title: Two Sunnah Rak'ahs Before Fajr
items.arabicText: سُنَّةُ الْفَجْرِ
items.transliteration: Sunnat al-Fajr
items.translation: The two Sunnah rak'ahs prayed before the Fajr fard.
items.hadithVirtue: The two rak'ahs of Fajr are better than the world and all it contains.
items.sababAndAdabTip: Pray them calmly with short surahs — Al-Kafirun and Al-Ikhlas, as the Prophet ﷺ did (Muslim 726).

items.title: Fajr
items.arabicText: صَلَاةُ الْفَجْرِ
items.transliteration: Salat al-Fajr
items.translation: The Dawn Prayer — 2 rak'ahs fard.
items.hadithVirtue: Whoever prays Fajr is under the protection of Allah.
items.sababAndAdabTip: Sleep early, keep water by the bed, and make wudu as soon as the alarm rings.

items.title: Dhuhr
items.arabicText: صَلَاةُ الظُّهْرِ
items.transliteration: Salat adh-Dhuhr
items.translation: The Midday Prayer — 4 rak'ahs fard.
items.hadithVirtue: The five prayers are like a river at your door in which you bathe five times a day.
items.sababAndAdabTip: Step away from work at the adhan — five unhurried minutes, then return refreshed.

items.title: Asr
items.arabicText: صَلَاةُ الْعَصْرِ
items.transliteration: Salat al-'Asr
items.translation: The Afternoon Prayer — 4 rak'ahs fard.
items.hadithVirtue: Whoever misses Asr, it is as if he lost his family and his wealth.
items.sababAndAdabTip: Pray before your last meeting or errand of the afternoon — Asr is the easiest to let slip.

items.title: Maghrib
items.arabicText: صَلَاةُ الْمَغْرِبِ
items.transliteration: Salat al-Maghrib
items.translation: The Sunset Prayer — 3 rak'ahs fard.
items.hadithVirtue: My ummah will remain upon good as long as they do not delay Maghrib until the stars appear.
items.sababAndAdabTip: Pray right after sunset, before dinner — its window is short.

items.title: Isha
items.arabicText: صَلَاةُ الْعِشَاءِ
items.transliteration: Salat al-'Isha'
items.translation: The Night Prayer — 4 rak'ahs fard.
items.hadithVirtue: Whoever prays Isha in congregation, it is as if he prayed half the night.
items.sababAndAdabTip: Pray Isha before screens and late conversations, then head to bed early.

items.title: Witr
items.arabicText: صَلَاةُ الْوِتْرِ
items.transliteration: Salat al-Witr
items.translation: The Witr Prayer — 3 rak'ahs after Isha, with Du'a al-Qunut.
items.hadithVirtue: Allah is Witr and loves the witr, so pray witr, O people of the Quran.
items.sababAndAdabTip: If you fear you won't wake for the night prayer, pray Witr right after Isha.

items.title: Ayat al-Kursi (2:255)
items.hadithVirtue: Recited at bedtime, a guardian from Allah stays with you and no devil approaches until morning.
items.virtueReference: Sahih al-Bukhari 2311; after each fard prayer: an-Nasa'i, as-Sunan al-Kubra 9928
items.sababAndAdabTip: Stay seated a moment after salam — read it before reaching for your phone.

ayahs.arabicText: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٌۭ وَلَا نَوْمٌۭ ۚ لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَىْءٍۢ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
ayahs.transliteration: Allahu laaa ilaaha illaa Huwal Haiyul Qaiyoom; laa taakhuzuhoo sinatunw wa laa nawm; lahoo maa fissamaawaati wa maa fil ard; man zal lazee yashfa'u indahooo illaa bi-iznih; ya'lamu maa baina aydeehim wa mww khalfahum wa laa yuheetoona bishai'im min 'ilmihee illaa bimaa shaaa'; wasi'a Kursiyyuhus samaawaati wal arda wa laa ya'ooduho hifzuhumaa; wa Huwal Aliyyul 'Azeem
ayahs.translation: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.

items.title: Tasbih After Prayer (33 · 33 · 33 + 1)
items.arabicText: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.transliteration: SubhanAllah (×33), Alhamdulillah (×33), Allahu akbar (×33), then: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir.
items.translation: Glory be to Allah (×33), all praise is for Allah (×33), Allah is the Greatest (×33), then once: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is over all things capable.
items.hadithVirtue: His sins are forgiven, even if they are like the foam of the sea.
items.sababAndAdabTip: Count on the fingers of your right hand — they will speak for you (Abi Dawud 1501).

items.title: Help Me to Remember and Thank You
items.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ، وَشُكْرِكَ، وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma a'inni 'ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni 'ibadatik.
items.translation: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You well.
items.hadithVirtue: The Prophet ﷺ told Mu'adh: "I love you — never leave saying this after every prayer."
items.sababAndAdabTip: Pick one blessing from today and name it in your heart as you say it.

items.title: Sayyid al-Istighfar (Master of Seeking Forgiveness)
items.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa ant, khalaqtani wa ana 'abduk, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata't, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana't, abu'u laka bini'matika 'alayya, wa abu'u bidhanbi faghfir li, fa innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant.
items.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord; none has the right to be worshipped except You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I keep Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favour upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.
items.hadithVirtue: Whoever says it with firm faith and dies that day or night is among the people of Paradise.
items.sababAndAdabTip: Name one specific mistake from yesterday and resolve to put it right today.

items.title: Protection: Bismillahilladhi La Yadurru
items.arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
items.transliteration: Bismillahilladhi la yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama', wa huwas-sami'ul-'alim.
items.translation: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in the heavens can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
items.hadithVirtue: Whoever says it three times in the morning and evening, nothing will harm him.
items.sababAndAdabTip: Say it before you start the day's tasks — then plan carefully and act with care.

items.title: Asbahna wa Asbahal-Mulku Lillah
items.arabicText: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
items.transliteration: Asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillah, wal-hamdu lillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. Rabbi as'aluka khayra ma fi hadhal-yawmi wa khayra ma ba'dah, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fi hadhal-yawmi wa sharri ma ba'dah. Rabbi a'udhu bika minal-kasali wa su'il-kibar. Rabbi a'udhu bika min 'adhabin fin-nari wa 'adhabin fil-qabr.
items.translation: We have entered the morning and the whole kingdom belongs to Allah, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is over all things capable. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good of what follows it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the misery of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from punishment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.
items.hadithVirtue: The Prophet ﷺ said it every morning; in the evening say "Amsayna wa amsal-mulku lillah … hadhihil-laylah …".
items.sababAndAdabTip: Glance at the sky for a moment and choose the first good deed of your day.

items.title: SubhanAllahi wa Bihamdihi
items.arabicText: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
items.transliteration: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi.
items.translation: Glory be to Allah and all praise is His.
items.hadithVirtue: Said 100 times morning and evening, no one brings anything better on the Day of Resurrection except one who said more.
items.sababAndAdabTip: Pair it with your commute or a short walk — 100 takes under two minutes.

items.title: Leaving the Home
items.arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillah, tawakkaltu 'alallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
items.translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might nor power except with Allah.
items.hadithVirtue: It is said to him: "You are guided, defended and protected," and the devil turns away from him.
items.sababAndAdabTip: Check your keys and step out with your right foot.

items.title: Entering the Home
items.arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
items.transliteration: Bismillahi walajna, wa bismillahi kharajna, wa 'alallahi rabbina tawakkalna.
items.translation: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon Allah our Lord we place our trust. (Then greet the household with salam.)
items.hadithVirtue: Mentioning Allah on entering denies the devil a place to stay the night.
items.sababAndAdabTip: Enter with a warm smile and say Assalamu Alaikum to your family.

items.title: Riding a Vehicle
items.arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
items.transliteration: Bismillah, alhamdulillah. Subhanalladhi sakh-khara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin, wa inna ila rabbina lamunqalibun. Alhamdulillah, alhamdulillah, alhamdulillah. Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar. Subhanaka Allahumma inni zalamtu nafsi faghfir li, fa innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant.
items.translation: In the name of Allah, all praise is for Allah. Glory be to the One who has subjected this to us, and we could never have done so ourselves, and indeed to our Lord we will return (43:13–14). All praise is for Allah (×3). Allah is the Greatest (×3). Glory be to You, O Allah; I have wronged myself, so forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.
items.hadithVirtue: The Prophet ﷺ said it on mounting his ride, then smiled: Allah is pleased when His servant says "forgive me".
items.sababAndAdabTip: Wear your seatbelt, drive calmly, and yield to others.

ayahs.arabicText: لِتَسْتَوُۥا۟ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِۦ ثُمَّ تَذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَةَ رَبِّكُمْ إِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَتَقُولُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُۥ مُقْرِنِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Litastawoo 'alaa zuhoorihee summa tazkuroo ni'mata Rabbikum izastawaitum 'alaihi wa taqooloo Subhaanal lazee sakhkhara lana haaza wa maa kunnaa lahoo muqrineen
ayahs.translation: That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say. "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it.

ayahs.arabicText: وَإِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa innaaa ilaa Rabbinaa lamunqaliboon
ayahs.translation: And indeed we, to our Lord, will [surely] return."

items.title: Setting Out on a Journey
items.arabicText: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ، وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ، وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ
items.transliteration: Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar. Subhanalladhi sakh-khara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin, wa inna ila rabbina lamunqalibun. Allahumma inna nas'aluka fi safarina hadhal-birra wat-taqwa, wa minal-'amali ma tarda. Allahumma hawwin 'alayna safarana hadha watwi 'anna bu'dah. Allahumma antas-sahibu fis-safar, wal-khalifatu fil-ahl. Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min wa'tha'is-safar, wa ka'abatil-manzar, wa su'il-munqalabi fil-mali wal-ahl.
items.translation: Allah is the Greatest (×3). Glory be to the One who has subjected this to us, and we could never have done so ourselves, and indeed to our Lord we will return. O Allah, we ask You on this journey of ours for righteousness and piety, and for deeds that please You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and shorten its distance. O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the Guardian of the family. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardships of travel, from a distressing sight, and from an evil return to my wealth and family.
items.hadithVirtue: The Prophet ﷺ said it whenever he set out on a journey.
items.sababAndAdabTip: Check fuel and route before you leave, and tell your family when to expect you.

ayahs.arabicText: لِتَسْتَوُۥا۟ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِۦ ثُمَّ تَذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَةَ رَبِّكُمْ إِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَتَقُولُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُۥ مُقْرِنِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Litastawoo 'alaa zuhoorihee summa tazkuroo ni'mata Rabbikum izastawaitum 'alaihi wa taqooloo Subhaanal lazee sakhkhara lana haaza wa maa kunnaa lahoo muqrineen
ayahs.translation: That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say. "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it.

ayahs.arabicText: وَإِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa innaaa ilaa Rabbinaa lamunqaliboon
ayahs.translation: And indeed we, to our Lord, will [surely] return."

items.title: The Three Quls (Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, An-Nas)
items.hadithVirtue: Recited three times morning and evening, they suffice you against everything.
items.virtueReference: Sunan Abi Dawud 5082; Jami' at-Tirmidhi 3575; before sleep: Sahih al-Bukhari 5017
items.sababAndAdabTip: At bedtime, blow into cupped hands after reciting and wipe over your body, as the Prophet ﷺ did.

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
ayahs.transliteration: Qul huwal laahu ahad
ayahs.translation: Say, "He is Allah, [who is] One,

ayahs.arabicText: ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ
ayahs.transliteration: Allah hus-samad
ayahs.translation: Allah, the Eternal Refuge.

ayahs.arabicText: لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
ayahs.transliteration: Lam yalid wa lam yoolad
ayahs.translation: He neither begets nor is born,

ayahs.arabicText: وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa lam yakul-lahu kufuwan ahad
ayahs.translation: Nor is there to Him any equivalent."

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ
ayahs.transliteration: Qul a'uzoo bi rabbil-falaq
ayahs.translation: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak

ayahs.arabicText: مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
ayahs.transliteration: Min sharri ma khalaq
ayahs.translation: From the evil of that which He created

ayahs.arabicText: وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa min sharri ghasiqin iza waqab
ayahs.translation: And from the evil of darkness when it settles

ayahs.arabicText: وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa min sharrin-naffaa-thaati fil 'uqad
ayahs.translation: And from the evil of the blowers in knots

ayahs.arabicText: وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa min shar ri haasidin iza hasad
ayahs.translation: And from the evil of an envier when he envies."

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ
ayahs.transliteration: Qul a'uzu birabbin naas
ayahs.translation: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,

ayahs.arabicText: مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ
ayahs.transliteration: Malikin naas
ayahs.translation: The Sovereign of mankind.

ayahs.arabicText: إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ
ayahs.transliteration: Ilaahin naas
ayahs.translation: The God of mankind,

ayahs.arabicText: مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ
ayahs.transliteration: Min sharril was waasil khannaas
ayahs.translation: From the evil of the retreating whisperer -

ayahs.arabicText: ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ
ayahs.transliteration: Al lazee yuwas wisu fee sudoorin naas
ayahs.translation: Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -

ayahs.arabicText: مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
ayahs.transliteration: Minal jinnati wan naas
ayahs.translation: From among the jinn and mankind."

items.arabicText:
بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ﴿١﴾ ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ ﴿٢﴾ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ﴿٣﴾ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ ﴿٤﴾
بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ ﴿١﴾ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ﴿٢﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ﴿٣﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ ﴿٤﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ ﴿٥﴾
بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ ﴿١﴾ مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ ﴿٢﴾ إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ ﴿٣﴾ مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ ﴿٤﴾ ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ ﴿٥﴾ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ ﴿٦﴾
items.transliteration:
Bismillaahir Rahmaanir Raheem Qul huwal laahu ahad Allah hus-samad Lam yalid wa lam yoolad Wa lam yakul-lahu kufuwan ahad
Bismillaahir Rahmaanir Raheem Qul a'uzoo bi rabbil-falaq Min sharri ma khalaq Wa min sharri ghasiqin iza waqab Wa min sharrin-naffaa-thaati fil 'uqad Wa min shar ri haasidin iza hasad
Bismillaahir Rahmaanir Raheem Qul a'uzu birabbin naas Malikin naas Ilaahin naas Min sharril was waasil khannaas Al lazee yuwas wisu fee sudoorin naas Minal jinnati wan naas
items.translation:
In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. Say, "He is Allah, [who is] One, Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, Nor is there to Him any equivalent."
In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak From the evil of that which He created And from the evil of darkness when it settles And from the evil of the blowers in knots And from the evil of an envier when he envies."
In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, The Sovereign of mankind. The God of mankind, From the evil of the retreating whisperer - Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind - From among the jinn and mankind."

items.title: Last Two Ayahs of Al-Baqarah (2:285–286)
items.hadithVirtue: Whoever recites them at night, they will suffice him.
items.sababAndAdabTip: Read them slowly with the meaning — they are a complete dua for ease and forgiveness.

ayahs.arabicText: ءَامَنَ ٱلرَّسُولُ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَلَٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍۢ مِّن رُّسُلِهِۦ ۚ وَقَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
ayahs.transliteration: Aamanar-Rasoolu bimaaa unzila ilaihi mir-Rabbihee walmu'minoon; kullun aamana billaahi wa Malaaa'ikathihee wa Kutubhihee wa Rusulih laa nufarriqu baina ahadim-mir-Rusulihee wa qaaloo sami'naa wa ata'naa ghufraanaka Rabbanaa wa ilaikal-maseer
ayahs.translation: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers, [saying], "We make no distinction between any of His messengers." And they say, "We hear and we obey. [We seek] Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the [final] destination."

ayahs.arabicText: لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا ٱكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَآ إِصْرًۭا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦ ۖ وَٱعْفُ عَنَّا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَآ ۚ أَنتَ مَوْلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Laa yukalliful-laahu nafsan illaa wus'ahaa; lahaa maa kasabat wa 'alaihaa maktasabat; Rabbanaa la tu'aakhiznaa in naseenaaa aw akhtaanaa; Rabbanaa wa laa tahmil-'alainaaa isran kamaa hamaltahoo 'alal-lazeena min qablinaa; Rabbanaa wa laa tuhammilnaa maa laa taaqata lanaa bih wa'fu 'annaa waghfir lanaa warhamnaa; Anta mawlaanaa fansurnaa 'alal qawmil kaafireen
ayahs.translation: Allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity. It will have [the consequence of] what [good] it has gained, and it will bear [the consequence of] what [evil] it has earned. "Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people."

items.title: Surah Al-Mulk
items.hadithVirtue: A surah of thirty ayahs interceded for a man until he was forgiven; the Prophet ﷺ would not sleep until he recited it.
items.sababAndAdabTip: Read it after Isha before screens; split it into two halves if it feels long.

ayahs.arabicText: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ
ayahs.transliteration: Tabaarakal lazee biyadihil mulku wa huwa 'alaa kulli shai-in qadeer
ayahs.translation: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -

ayahs.arabicText: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَٱلْحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًۭا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفُورُ
ayahs.transliteration: Allazee khalaqal mawta walhayaata liyabluwakum ayyukum ahsanu 'amalaa; wa huwal 'azeezul ghafoor
ayahs.translation: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving -

ayahs.arabicText: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍۢ طِبَاقًۭا ۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مِن تَفَٰوُتٍۢ ۖ فَٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Allazee khalaqa sab'a samaawaatin tibaaqam maa taraa fee khalqir rahmaani min tafaawutin farji'il basara hal taraa min futoor
ayahs.translation: [And] who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks?

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ ٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًۭا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Summar ji'il basara karrataini yanqalib ilaikal basaru khaasi'anw wa huwa haseer
ayahs.translation: Then return [your] vision twice again. [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued.

ayahs.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَٰهَا رُجُومًۭا لِّلشَّيَٰطِينِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa laqad zaiyannas samaaa'ad dunyaa bimasaa beeha wa ja'alnaahaa rujoomal lish shayaateeni wa a'tadnaa lahum 'azaabas sa'eer
ayahs.translation: And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with stars and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.

ayahs.arabicText: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa lillazeena kafaroo bi rabbihim 'azaabu jahannama wa bi'sal maseer
ayahs.translation: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.

ayahs.arabicText: إِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ فِيهَا سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا شَهِيقًۭا وَهِىَ تَفُورُ
ayahs.transliteration: Izaaa ulqoo feehaa sami'oo lahaa shaheeqanw wa hiya tafoor
ayahs.translation: When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a [dreadful] inhaling while it boils up.

ayahs.arabicText: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلْغَيْظِ ۖ كُلَّمَآ أُلْقِىَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌۭ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Takaadu tamayyazu minal ghaizi kullamaaa uliqya feehaa fawjun sa alahum khazanatuhaaa alam yaatikum nazeer
ayahs.translation: It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرٌۭ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ كَبِيرٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo balaa qad jaaa'anaa nazeerun fakazzabnaa wa qulnaa maa nazzalal laahu min shai in in antum illaa fee dalaalin kabeer
ayahs.translation: They will say," Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allah has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error.'"

ayahs.arabicText: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِىٓ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa qaaloo law kunnaa nasma'u awna'qilu maa kunnaa feee as haabis sa'eer
ayahs.translation: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze."

ayahs.arabicText: فَٱعْتَرَفُوا۟ بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًۭا لِّأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa'tarafoo bizambihim fasuhqal li as haabis sa'eer
ayahs.translation: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the Blaze.

ayahs.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَأَجْرٌۭ كَبِيرٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Innal lazeena yakhshawna rabbahum bilghaibi lahum maghfiratunw wa ajrun kabeer
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.

ayahs.arabicText: وَأَسِرُّوا۟ قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ ٱجْهَرُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa asirroo qawlakum awijharoo bihee innahoo 'aleemum bizaatis sudoor
ayahs.translation: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

ayahs.arabicText: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
ayahs.transliteration: Alaa ya'lamu man khalaq wa huwal lateeful khabeer
ayahs.translation: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Acquainted?

ayahs.arabicText: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًۭا فَٱمْشُوا۟ فِى مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِهِۦ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ
ayahs.transliteration: Huwal lazee ja'ala lakumul arda zaloolan famshoo fee manaakibihaa wa kuloo mir rizqihee wa ilaihin nushoor
ayahs.translation: It is He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection.

ayahs.arabicText: ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَمُورُ
ayahs.transliteration: 'A-amintum man fissamaaa'i aiyakhsifa bi kumul arda fa izaa hiya tamoor
ayahs.translation: Do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?

ayahs.arabicText: أَمْ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًۭا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ
ayahs.transliteration: Am amintum man fissamaaa'i ai yursila 'alaikum haasiban fasata'lamoona kaifa nazeer
ayahs.translation: Or do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning.

ayahs.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa laqad kazzabal lazeena min qablihim fakaifa kaana nakeer
ayahs.translation: And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach.

ayahs.arabicText: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَٰٓفَّٰتٍۢ وَيَقْبِضْنَ ۚ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍۭ بَصِيرٌ
ayahs.transliteration: Awalam yaraw ilat tairi fawqahum saaaffaatinw wa yaqbidn; maa yumsikuhunna illaar rahmaan; innahoo bikulli shai im baseer
ayahs.translation: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? None holds them [aloft] except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing.

ayahs.arabicText: أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ جُندٌۭ لَّكُمْ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۚ إِنِ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ إِلَّا فِى غُرُورٍ
ayahs.transliteration: Amman haazal lazee huwa jundul lakum yansurukum min doonir rahmaan; inilkaafiroona illaa fee ghuroor
ayahs.translation: Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion.

ayahs.arabicText: أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّجُّوا۟ فِى عُتُوٍّۢ وَنُفُورٍ
ayahs.transliteration: Amman haazal lazee yarzuqukum in amsaka rizqah; bal lajjoo fee 'utuwwinw wa nufoor
ayahs.translation: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion.

ayahs.arabicText: أَفَمَن يَمْشِى مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦٓ أَهْدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمْشِى سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Afamai yamshee mukibban 'alaa wajhihee ahdaaa ammany yamshee sawiyyan 'alaa siratim mustaqeem
ayahs.translation: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Qul huwal lazee ansha akum wa ja'ala lakumus sam'a wal absaara wal af'idata qaleelam maa tashkuroon
ayahs.translation: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful."

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Qul huwal lazee zara akum fil ardi wa ilaihi tuhsharoon
ayahs.translation: Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered."

ayahs.arabicText: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa yaqooloona mataa haazal wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen
ayahs.translation: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Qul innamal 'ilmu 'indallaahi wa innamaaa ana nazeerum mubeen
ayahs.translation: Say, "The knowledge is only with Allah, and I am only a clear warner."

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةًۭ سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Falaammaa ra-awhu zulfatan seee'at wujoohul lazeena kafaroo wa qeela haazal lazee kuntum bihee tadda'oon
ayahs.translation: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call."

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Qul ara'aytum in ahlaka niyal laahu wa mam ma'iya aw rahimanaa famai-yujeerul kaafireena min 'azaabin aleem
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muhammad], "Have you considered: whether Allah should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?"

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Qul huwar rahmaanu aamannaa bihee wa 'alaihi tawakkalnaa fasata'lamoona man huwa fee dalaalim mubeen
ayahs.translation: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error."

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًۭا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍۢ مَّعِينٍۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Qul ara'aytum in asbaha maaa'ukum ghawran famai yaateekum bimaaa'im ma'een
ayahs.translation: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"

items.arabicText: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ
items.transliteration: Tabaarakal lazee biyadihil mulku wa huwa 'alaa kulli shai-in qadeer
items.translation: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -

items.title: Surah Al-Waqi'ah
items.hadithVirtue: Narrated: whoever recites Al-Waqi'ah every night will never be struck by poverty. Its chain is weak (da'if).
items.virtueReference: Ibn Mas'ud, reported by al-Bayhaqi (Shu'ab al-Iman) and Ibn as-Sunni; graded da'if
items.sababAndAdabTip: Pair it with honest effort in your work and contentment with what you have.

ayahs.arabicText: إِذَا وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
ayahs.transliteration: Izaa waqa'atil waaqi'ah
ayahs.translation: When the Occurrence occurs,

ayahs.arabicText: لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ
ayahs.transliteration: Laisa liwaq'atihaa kaazibah
ayahs.translation: There is, at its occurrence, no denial.

ayahs.arabicText: خَافِضَةٌۭ رَّافِعَةٌ
ayahs.transliteration: Khafidatur raafi'ah
ayahs.translation: It will bring down [some] and raise up [others].

ayahs.arabicText: إِذَا رُجَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ رَجًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Izaa rujjatil ardu rajjaa
ayahs.translation: When the earth is shaken with convulsion

ayahs.arabicText: وَبُسَّتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ بَسًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa bussatil jibaalu bassaa
ayahs.translation: And the mountains are broken down, crumbling

ayahs.arabicText: فَكَانَتْ هَبَآءًۭ مُّنۢبَثًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Fakaanat habaaa'am mumbassaa
ayahs.translation: And become dust dispersing.

ayahs.arabicText: وَكُنتُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا ثَلَٰثَةًۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa kuntum azwaajan salaasah
ayahs.translation: And you become [of] three kinds:

ayahs.arabicText: فَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa as haabul maimanati maaa as haabul maimanah
ayahs.translation: Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?

ayahs.arabicText: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa as haabul mash'amati maaa as haabul mash'amah
ayahs.translation: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?

ayahs.arabicText: وَٱلسَّٰبِقُونَ ٱلسَّٰبِقُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wassaabiqoonas saabiqoon
ayahs.translation: And the forerunners, the forerunners -

ayahs.arabicText: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Ulaaa'ikal muqarraboon
ayahs.translation: Those are the ones brought near [to Allah]

ayahs.arabicText: فِى جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fee Jannaatin Na'eem
ayahs.translation: In the Gardens of Pleasure,

ayahs.arabicText: ثُلَّةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Sullatum minal awwaleen
ayahs.translation: A [large] company of the former peoples

ayahs.arabicText: وَقَلِيلٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa qaleelum minal aa khireen
ayahs.translation: And a few of the later peoples,

ayahs.arabicText: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مَّوْضُونَةٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: 'Alaa sururim mawdoonah
ayahs.translation: On thrones woven [with ornament],

ayahs.arabicText: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَيْهَا مُتَقَٰبِلِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Muttaki'eena 'alaihaa mutaqabileen
ayahs.translation: Reclining on them, facing each other.

ayahs.arabicText: يَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌۭ مُّخَلَّدُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Yatoofu 'alaihim wildaa num mukkhalladoon
ayahs.translation: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal

ayahs.arabicText: بِأَكْوَابٍۢ وَأَبَارِيقَ وَكَأْسٍۢ مِّن مَّعِينٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Bi akwaabinw wa abaareeq, wa kaasim mim ma'een
ayahs.translation: With vessels, pitchers and a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring -

ayahs.arabicText: لَّا يُصَدَّعُونَ عَنْهَا وَلَا يُنزِفُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Laa yusadda'oona 'anhaa wa laa yunzifoon
ayahs.translation: No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated -

ayahs.arabicText: وَفَٰكِهَةٍۢ مِّمَّا يَتَخَيَّرُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa faakihatim mimmaa yatakhaiyaroon
ayahs.translation: And fruit of what they select

ayahs.arabicText: وَلَحْمِ طَيْرٍۢ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa lahmi tairim mimmaa yashtahoon
ayahs.translation: And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire.

ayahs.arabicText: وَحُورٌ عِينٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa hoorun'een
ayahs.translation: And [for them are] fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes,

ayahs.arabicText: كَأَمْثَٰلِ ٱللُّؤْلُؤِ ٱلْمَكْنُونِ
ayahs.transliteration: Ka amsaalil lu'lu'il maknoon
ayahs.translation: The likenesses of pearls well-protected,

ayahs.arabicText: جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Jazaaa'am bimaa kaanoo ya'maloon
ayahs.translation: As reward for what they used to do.

ayahs.arabicText: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًۭا وَلَا تَأْثِيمًا
ayahs.transliteration: Laa yasma'oona feehaa laghwanw wa laa taaseemaa
ayahs.translation: They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin -

ayahs.arabicText: إِلَّا قِيلًۭا سَلَٰمًۭا سَلَٰمًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Illaa qeelan salaaman salaamaa
ayahs.translation: Only a saying: "Peace, peace."

ayahs.arabicText: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْيَمِينِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْيَمِينِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa as haabul yameeni maaa as haabul Yameen
ayahs.translation: The companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?

ayahs.arabicText: فِى سِدْرٍۢ مَّخْضُودٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Fee sidrim makhdood
ayahs.translation: [They will be] among lote trees with thorns removed

ayahs.arabicText: وَطَلْحٍۢ مَّنضُودٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa talhim mandood
ayahs.translation: And [banana] trees layered [with fruit]

ayahs.arabicText: وَظِلٍّۢ مَّمْدُودٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa zillim mamdood
ayahs.translation: And shade extended

ayahs.arabicText: وَمَآءٍۢ مَّسْكُوبٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maaa'im maskoob
ayahs.translation: And water poured out

ayahs.arabicText: وَفَٰكِهَةٍۢ كَثِيرَةٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa faakihatin kaseerah
ayahs.translation: And fruit, abundant [and varied],

ayahs.arabicText: لَّا مَقْطُوعَةٍۢ وَلَا مَمْنُوعَةٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Laa maqtoo'atinw wa laa mamnoo'ah
ayahs.translation: Neither limited [to season] nor forbidden,

ayahs.arabicText: وَفُرُشٍۢ مَّرْفُوعَةٍ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa furushim marfoo'ah
ayahs.translation: And [upon] beds raised high.

ayahs.arabicText: إِنَّآ أَنشَأْنَٰهُنَّ إِنشَآءًۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Innaaa anshaanaahunna inshaaa'aa
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We have produced the women of Paradise in a [new] creation

ayahs.arabicText: فَجَعَلْنَٰهُنَّ أَبْكَارًا
ayahs.transliteration: Faja'alnaahunna abkaaraa
ayahs.translation: And made them virgins,

ayahs.arabicText: عُرُبًا أَتْرَابًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: 'Uruban atraabaa
ayahs.translation: Devoted [to their husbands] and of equal age,

ayahs.arabicText: لِّأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
ayahs.transliteration: Li as haabil yameen
ayahs.translation: For the companions of the right [who are]

ayahs.arabicText: ثُلَّةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Sullatum minal awwa leen
ayahs.translation: A company of the former peoples

ayahs.arabicText: وَثُلَّةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa sullatum minal aakhireen
ayahs.translation: And a company of the later peoples.

ayahs.arabicText: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa as haabush shimaali maaa as haabush shimaal
ayahs.translation: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?

ayahs.arabicText: فِى سَمُومٍۢ وَحَمِيمٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Fee samoominw wa hameem
ayahs.translation: [They will be] in scorching fire and scalding water

ayahs.arabicText: وَظِلٍّۢ مِّن يَحْمُومٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa zillim miny yahmoom
ayahs.translation: And a shade of black smoke,

ayahs.arabicText: لَّا بَارِدٍۢ وَلَا كَرِيمٍ
ayahs.transliteration: Laa baaridinw wa laa kareem
ayahs.translation: Neither cool nor beneficial.

ayahs.arabicText: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُتْرَفِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Innaahum kaanoo qabla zaalika mutrafeen
ayahs.translation: Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence,

ayahs.arabicText: وَكَانُوا۟ يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى ٱلْحِنثِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa kaanoo yusirroona 'alal hinsil 'azeem
ayahs.translation: And they used to persist in the great violation,

ayahs.arabicText: وَكَانُوا۟ يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa kaanoo yaqooloona a'izaa mitnaa wa kunnaa turaabanw wa izaaman'ainnaa lamab'oosoon
ayahs.translation: And they used to say, "When we die and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?

ayahs.arabicText: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Awa aabaaa'unal awwaloon
ayahs.translation: And our forefathers [as well]?"

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ وَٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Qul innal awwaleena wal aakhireen
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, the former and the later peoples

ayahs.arabicText: لَمَجْمُوعُونَ إِلَىٰ مِيقَٰتِ يَوْمٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Lamajmoo'oona ilaa meeqaati yawmim ma'loon
ayahs.translation: Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day."

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ ٱلْمُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: summa innakum ayyuhad daaalloonal mukazziboon
ayahs.translation: Then indeed you, O those astray [who are] deniers,

ayahs.arabicText: لَءَاكِلُونَ مِن شَجَرٍۢ مِّن زَقُّومٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: La aakiloona min shaja rim min zaqqoom
ayahs.translation: Will be eating from trees of zaqqum

ayahs.arabicText: فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Famaali'oona minhal butoon
ayahs.translation: And filling with it your bellies

ayahs.arabicText: فَشَٰرِبُونَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fashaariboona 'alaihi minal hameem
ayahs.translation: And drinking on top of it from scalding water

ayahs.arabicText: فَشَٰرِبُونَ شُرْبَ ٱلْهِيمِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fashaariboona shurbal heem
ayahs.translation: And will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels.

ayahs.arabicText: هَٰذَا نُزُلُهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.transliteration: Haazaa nuzuluhum yawmad deen
ayahs.translation: That is their accommodation on the Day of Recompense.

ayahs.arabicText: نَحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ فَلَوْلَا تُصَدِّقُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Nahnu khalaqnaakum falaw laa tusaddiqoon
ayahs.translation: We have created you, so why do you not believe?

ayahs.arabicText: أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تُمْنُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Afara'aytum maa tumnoon
ayahs.translation: Have you seen that which you emit?

ayahs.arabicText: ءَأَنتُمْ تَخْلُقُونَهُۥٓ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: 'A-antum takhluqoo nahooo am nahnul khaaliqoon
ayahs.translation: Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator?

ayahs.arabicText: نَحْنُ قَدَّرْنَا بَيْنَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Nahnu qaddarnaa baina kumul mawta wa maa nahnu bimasbooqeen
ayahs.translation: We have decreed death among you, and We are not to be outdone

ayahs.arabicText: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ أَمْثَٰلَكُمْ وَنُنشِئَكُمْ فِى مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: 'Alaaa an nubaddila amsaalakum wa nunshi'akum fee maa laa ta'lamoon
ayahs.translation: In that We will change your likenesses and produce you in that [form] which you do not know.

ayahs.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ فَلَوْلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa laqad 'alimtumun nash atal oolaa falaw laa tazakkaroon
ayahs.translation: And you have already known the first creation, so will you not remember?

ayahs.arabicText: أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تَحْرُثُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Afara'aytum maa tahrusoon
ayahs.translation: And have you seen that [seed] which you sow?

ayahs.arabicText: ءَأَنتُمْ تَزْرَعُونَهُۥٓ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلزَّٰرِعُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: 'A-antum tazra'oonahooo am nahnuz zaari'ooon
ayahs.translation: Is it you who makes it grow, or are We the grower?

ayahs.arabicText: لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَٰهُ حُطَٰمًۭا فَظَلْتُمْ تَفَكَّهُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Law nashaaa'u laja'al naahu hutaaman fazaltum tafakkahoon
ayahs.translation: If We willed, We could make it [dry] debris, and you would remain in wonder,

ayahs.arabicText: إِنَّا لَمُغْرَمُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Innaa lamughramoon
ayahs.translation: [Saying], "Indeed, we are [now] in debt;

ayahs.arabicText: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Bal nahnu mahroomoon
ayahs.translation: Rather, we have been deprived."

ayahs.arabicText: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱلْمَآءَ ٱلَّذِى تَشْرَبُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Afara'aytumul maaa'allazee tashraboon
ayahs.translation: And have you seen the water that you drink?

ayahs.arabicText: ءَأَنتُمْ أَنزَلْتُمُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُزْنِ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنزِلُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: 'A-antum anzaltumoohu minal muzni am nahnul munziloon
ayahs.translation: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds, or is it We who bring it down?

ayahs.arabicText: لَوْ نَشَآءُ جَعَلْنَٰهُ أُجَاجًۭا فَلَوْلَا تَشْكُرُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Law nashaaa'u ja'alnaahu ujaajan falaw laa tashkuroon
ayahs.translation: If We willed, We could make it bitter, so why are you not grateful?

ayahs.arabicText: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱلنَّارَ ٱلَّتِى تُورُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Afara'aytumun naaral latee tooroon
ayahs.translation: And have you seen the fire that you ignite?

ayahs.arabicText: ءَأَنتُمْ أَنشَأْتُمْ شَجَرَتَهَآ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنشِـُٔونَ
ayahs.transliteration: 'A-antum anshaatum shajaratahaaa am nahnul munshi'oon
ayahs.translation: Is it you who produced its tree, or are We the producer?

ayahs.arabicText: نَحْنُ جَعَلْنَٰهَا تَذْكِرَةًۭ وَمَتَٰعًۭا لِّلْمُقْوِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Nahnu ja'alnaahaa tazkira tanw wa mataa'al lilmuqween
ayahs.translation: We have made it a reminder and provision for the travelers,

ayahs.arabicText: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fasabbih bismi Rabbikal 'azeem
ayahs.translation: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.

ayahs.arabicText: ۞ فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِمَوَٰقِعِ ٱلنُّجُومِ
ayahs.transliteration: Falaa uqsimu bimaawaa qi'innujoom
ayahs.translation: Then I swear by the setting of the stars,

ayahs.arabicText: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَقَسَمٌۭ لَّوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عَظِيمٌ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa innahoo laqasamul lawta'lamoona'azeem
ayahs.translation: And indeed, it is an oath - if you could know - [most] great.

ayahs.arabicText: إِنَّهُۥ لَقُرْءَانٌۭ كَرِيمٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Innahoo la quraanun kareem
ayahs.translation: Indeed, it is a noble Qur'an

ayahs.arabicText: فِى كِتَٰبٍۢ مَّكْنُونٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Fee kitaabim maknoon
ayahs.translation: In a Register well-protected;

ayahs.arabicText: لَّا يَمَسُّهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْمُطَهَّرُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Laa yamassuhooo illal mutahharoon
ayahs.translation: None touch it except the purified.

ayahs.arabicText: تَنزِيلٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Tanzeelum mir Rabbil'aalameen
ayahs.translation: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.

ayahs.arabicText: أَفَبِهَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ أَنتُم مُّدْهِنُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Afabihaazal hadeesi antum mudhinoon
ayahs.translation: Then is it to this statement that you are indifferent

ayahs.arabicText: وَتَجْعَلُونَ رِزْقَكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa taj'aloona rizqakum annakum tukazziboon
ayahs.translation: And make [the thanks for] your provision that you deny [the Provider]?

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَوْلَآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلْحُلْقُومَ
ayahs.transliteration: Falaw laaa izaa balaghatil hulqoom
ayahs.translation: Then why, when the soul at death reaches the throat

ayahs.arabicText: وَأَنتُمْ حِينَئِذٍۢ تَنظُرُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa antum heena'izin tanzuroon
ayahs.translation: And you are at that time looking on -

ayahs.arabicText: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنكُمْ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa nahnu aqrabu ilaihi minkum wa laakil laa tubsiroon
ayahs.translation: And Our angels are nearer to him than you, but you do not see -

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَوْلَآ إِن كُنتُمْ غَيْرَ مَدِينِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Falaw laaa in kuntum ghira madeeneen
ayahs.translation: Then why do you not, if you are not to be recompensed,

ayahs.arabicText: تَرْجِعُونَهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Tarji'oonahaaa in kuntum saadiqeen
ayahs.translation: Bring it back, if you should be truthful?

ayahs.arabicText: فَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa ammaaa in kaana minal muqarrabeen
ayahs.translation: And if the deceased was of those brought near to Allah,

ayahs.arabicText: فَرَوْحٌۭ وَرَيْحَانٌۭ وَجَنَّتُ نَعِيمٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Farawhunw wa raihaa nunw wa jannatu na'eem
ayahs.translation: Then [for him is] rest and bounty and a garden of pleasure.

ayahs.arabicText: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa ammaaa in kaana min as haabil yameen
ayahs.translation: And if he was of the companions of the right,

ayahs.arabicText: فَسَلَٰمٌۭ لَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fasalaamul laka min as haabil yameen
ayahs.translation: Then [the angels will say], "Peace for you; [you are] from the companions of the right."

ayahs.arabicText: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa ammaaa in kaana minal mukazzibeenad daaalleen
ayahs.translation: But if he was of the deniers [who were] astray,

ayahs.arabicText: فَنُزُلٌۭ مِّنْ حَمِيمٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Fanuzulum min hameem
ayahs.translation: Then [for him is] accommodation of scalding water

ayahs.arabicText: وَتَصْلِيَةُ جَحِيمٍ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa tasliyatu jaheem
ayahs.translation: And burning in Hellfire

ayahs.arabicText: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ حَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ
ayahs.transliteration: Inna haaza lahuwa haqqul yaqeen
ayahs.translation: Indeed, this is the true certainty,

ayahs.arabicText: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fasabbih bismi rabbikal 'azeem
ayahs.translation: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.

items.arabicText: إِذَا وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
items.transliteration: Izaa waqa'atil waaqi'ah
items.translation: When the Occurrence occurs,

items.title: Tasbih Fatimah (33 · 33 · 34)
items.arabicText: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
items.transliteration: SubhanAllah (×33), Alhamdulillah (×33), Allahu akbar (×34).
items.translation: Glory be to Allah (×33), all praise is for Allah (×33), Allah is the Greatest (×34).
items.hadithVirtue: Taught to Fatimah and Ali for bedtime: "It is better for you than a servant."
items.sababAndAdabTip: Lie on your right side and count on your fingers — even on the most tired night.

items.title: Before Sleeping
items.arabicText: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
items.transliteration: Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya.
items.translation: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
items.hadithVirtue: The Prophet ﷺ said it every night as he went to bed.
items.sababAndAdabTip: Sleep with wudu on your right side, as the Prophet ﷺ advised (Bukhari 247).

items.title: Refuge from Anxiety and Sorrow
items.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa dala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijal.
items.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, from weakness and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, and from the burden of debt and being overpowered by men.
items.hadithVirtue: The Prophet ﷺ often sought refuge with this supplication.
items.sababAndAdabTip: Write down what worries you, then do the one thing within your control.

items.title: Dua of Yunus (Dhun-Nun)
items.arabicText: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin.
items.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except You. Glory be to You; indeed, I have been among the wrongdoers. (21:87)
items.hadithVirtue: No Muslim supplicates with it for anything except that Allah answers him.
items.sababAndAdabTip: Admit your own part in the problem honestly, then take one small step to fix it.

items.title: Hasbunallahu wa Ni'mal Wakil
items.arabicText: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
items.transliteration: Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal-wakil.
items.translation: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs. (3:173)
items.hadithVirtue: Said by Ibrahim (peace be upon him) when thrown into the fire, and by Muhammad ﷺ when the people gathered against him.
items.sababAndAdabTip: Do your utmost first, then leave the outcome to Allah.

items.title: Supplication in Times of Distress
items.arabicText: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illallahul-'azimul-halim. La ilaha illallahu rabbul-'arshil-'azim. La ilaha illallahu rabbus-samawati wa rabbul-ardi wa rabbul-'arshil-karim.
items.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, the Magnificent, the Forbearing. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.
items.hadithVirtue: The Prophet ﷺ would say this in times of distress.
items.sababAndAdabTip: Make wudu, pray two rak'ahs, and talk it through with someone you trust.

items.title: Nothing Is Easy Except What You Make Easy
items.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا
items.transliteration: Allahumma la sahla illa ma ja'altahu sahla, wa anta taj'alul-hazna idha shi'ta sahla.
items.translation: O Allah, nothing is easy except what You make easy, and You make the difficult easy if You will.
items.hadithVirtue: A supplication of the Prophet ﷺ for when a matter becomes difficult.
items.sababAndAdabTip: Break the hard task into its next small step and start it now.

items.title: When It Rains
items.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا
items.transliteration: Allahumma sayyiban nafi'a.
items.translation: O Allah, (let it be) a beneficial rain.
items.hadithVirtue: The Prophet ﷺ said this whenever he saw rain.
items.sababAndAdabTip: Pause to feel the mercy for a moment, then drive carefully on wet roads.

items.title: On Seeing Something Pleasing
items.arabicText: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillahil-ladhi bi ni'matihi tatimmus-salihat.
items.translation: All praise is for Allah, by whose favour good things are completed.
items.hadithVirtue: The Prophet ﷺ said this when he saw something that pleased him.
items.sababAndAdabTip: Thank the person through whom the blessing came — whoever doesn't thank people doesn't thank Allah (Abi Dawud 4811).

items.title: Surah Al-Kahf
items.hadithVirtue: Whoever reads Al-Kahf on Friday, light will shine for him between the two Fridays.
items.sababAndAdabTip: Split it into two short sittings — Thursday night and Friday morning.

ayahs.arabicText: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَلَمْ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ عِوَجَا ۜ
ayahs.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil lazeee anzala 'alaa 'abdihil kitaaba wa lam yaj'al lahoo 'iwajaa
ayahs.translation: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, who has sent down upon His Servant the Book and has not made therein any deviance.

ayahs.arabicText: قَيِّمًۭا لِّيُنذِرَ بَأْسًۭا شَدِيدًۭا مِّن لَّدُنْهُ وَيُبَشِّرَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمْ أَجْرًا حَسَنًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Qaiyimal liyunzira baasan shadeedam mil ladunhu wa yubashshiral mu'mineenal lazeena ya'maloonas saalihaati anna lahum ajran hasanaa
ayahs.translation: [He has made it] straight, to warn of severe punishment from Him and to give good tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds that they will have a good reward

ayahs.arabicText: مَّٰكِثِينَ فِيهِ أَبَدًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Maakiseena feehi abadaa
ayahs.translation: In which they will remain forever

ayahs.arabicText: وَيُنذِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَدًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa yunziral lazeena qaalut takhazal laahu waladaa
ayahs.translation: And to warn those who say, "Allah has taken a son."

ayahs.arabicText: مَّا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍۢ وَلَا لِءَابَآئِهِمْ ۚ كَبُرَتْ كَلِمَةًۭ تَخْرُجُ مِنْ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ ۚ إِن يَقُولُونَ إِلَّا كَذِبًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Maa lahum bihee min 'ilminw wa laa li aabaaa'ihim; kaburat kalimatan takhruju min afwaahihim; iny yaqooloona illaa kazibaa
ayahs.translation: They have no knowledge of it, nor had their fathers. Grave is the word that comes out of their mouths; they speak not except a lie.

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٌۭ نَّفْسَكَ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِمْ إِن لَّمْ يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ أَسَفًا
ayahs.transliteration: Fala'allaka baakhi'un nafsaka 'alaaa aasaarihim illam yu;minoo bihaazal hadeesi asafaa
ayahs.translation: Then perhaps you would kill yourself through grief over them, [O Muhammad], if they do not believe in this message, [and] out of sorrow.

ayahs.arabicText: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا مَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ زِينَةًۭ لَّهَا لِنَبْلُوَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Innaa ja'alnaa ma 'alal ardi zeenatal lahaa linabluwahum ayyuhum ahsanu 'amalaa
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We have made that which is on the earth adornment for it that We may test them [as to] which of them is best in deed.

ayahs.arabicText: وَإِنَّا لَجَٰعِلُونَ مَا عَلَيْهَا صَعِيدًۭا جُرُزًا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa innaa lajaa 'iloona maa 'alaihaa sa'aeedan juruzaa
ayahs.translation: And indeed, We will make that which is upon it [into] a barren ground.

ayahs.arabicText: أَمْ حَسِبْتَ أَنَّ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْكَهْفِ وَٱلرَّقِيمِ كَانُوا۟ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا عَجَبًا
ayahs.transliteration: Am hasibta anna Ashaabal Kahfi war Raqeemi kaanoo min Aayaatinaa 'ajabaa
ayahs.translation: Or have you thought that the companions of the cave and the inscription were, among Our signs, a wonder?

ayahs.arabicText: إِذْ أَوَى ٱلْفِتْيَةُ إِلَى ٱلْكَهْفِ فَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةًۭ وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Iz awal fityatu ilal Kahfi faqaaloo Rabbanaaa aatinaa mil ladunka rahmatanw wa haiyi' lanaa min amrinaa rashadaa
ayahs.translation: [Mention] when the youths retreated to the cave and said, "Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance."

ayahs.arabicText: فَضَرَبْنَا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ فِى ٱلْكَهْفِ سِنِينَ عَدَدًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Fadarabnaa 'alaaa aazaanihim fil Kahfi seneena 'adadaa
ayahs.translation: So We cast [a cover of sleep] over their ears within the cave for a number of years.

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَٰهُمْ لِنَعْلَمَ أَىُّ ٱلْحِزْبَيْنِ أَحْصَىٰ لِمَا لَبِثُوٓا۟ أَمَدًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Summa ba'asnaahum lina'lama ayyul hizbaini ahsaa limaa labisooo amadaa
ayahs.translation: Then We awakened them that We might show which of the two factions was most precise in calculating what [extent] they had remained in time.

ayahs.arabicText: نَّحْنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ نَبَأَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ فِتْيَةٌ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ وَزِدْنَٰهُمْ هُدًۭى
ayahs.transliteration: Nahnu naqussu 'alaika naba ahum bilhaqq; innahum fityatun aamanoo bi Rabbihim wa zidnaahum hudaa
ayahs.translation: It is We who relate to you, [O Muhammad], their story in truth. Indeed, they were youths who believed in their Lord, and We increased them in guidance.

ayahs.arabicText: وَرَبَطْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ إِذْ قَامُوا۟ فَقَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ لَن نَّدْعُوَا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ إِلَٰهًۭا ۖ لَّقَدْ قُلْنَآ إِذًۭا شَطَطًا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa rabatnaa 'alaa quloo bihim iz qaamoo faqaaloo Rabbunaa Rabbus samaawaati wal ardi lan nad'uwa min dooniheee ilaahal laqad qulnaaa izan shatataa
ayahs.translation: And We made firm their hearts when they stood up and said, "Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth. Never will we invoke besides Him any deity. We would have certainly spoken, then, an excessive transgression.

ayahs.arabicText: هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمُنَا ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةًۭ ۖ لَّوْلَا يَأْتُونَ عَلَيْهِم بِسُلْطَٰنٍۭ بَيِّنٍۢ ۖ فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Haaa'ulaaa'i qawmunat takhazoo min dooniheee aalihatal law laa yaatoona 'alaihim bisultaanim baiyin; faman azlamu mimmaniftaraa 'alal laahi kazibaa
ayahs.translation: These, our people, have taken besides Him deities. Why do they not bring for [worship of] them a clear authority? And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allah a lie?"

ayahs.arabicText: وَإِذِ ٱعْتَزَلْتُمُوهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ فَأْوُۥٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلْكَهْفِ يَنشُرْ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِهِۦ وَيُهَيِّئْ لَكُم مِّنْ أَمْرِكُم مِّرْفَقًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izi'tazal tumoohum wa maa ya'budoona illal laaha faawooo ilal kahfi yanshur lakum Rabbukum mir rahmatihee wa yuhaiyi' lakum min amrikum mirfaqa
ayahs.translation: [The youths said to one another], "And when you have withdrawn from them and that which they worship other than Allah, retreat to the cave. Your Lord will spread out for you of His mercy and will prepare for you from your affair facility."

ayahs.arabicText: ۞ وَتَرَى ٱلشَّمْسَ إِذَا طَلَعَت تَّزَٰوَرُ عَن كَهْفِهِمْ ذَاتَ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَإِذَا غَرَبَت تَّقْرِضُهُمْ ذَاتَ ٱلشِّمَالِ وَهُمْ فِى فَجْوَةٍۢ مِّنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ مَن يَهْدِ ٱللَّهُ فَهُوَ ٱلْمُهْتَدِ ۖ وَمَن يُضْلِلْ فَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُۥ وَلِيًّۭا مُّرْشِدًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa tarash shamsa izaa tala'at tazaawaru 'an kahfihim zaatal yameeni wa izaa gharabat taqriduhum zaatash shimaali wa hum fee fajwatim minh; zaalika min Aayaatillaah; mai yahdil laahu fahuwal muhtad, wa mai yudlil falan tajida lahoo waliyyam murshidaa
ayahs.translation: And [had you been present], you would see the sun when it rose, inclining away from their cave on the right, and when it set, passing away from them on the left, while they were [laying] within an open space thereof. That was from the signs of Allah. He whom Allah guides is the [rightly] guided, but he whom He leaves astray - never will you find for him a protecting guide.

ayahs.arabicText: وَتَحْسَبُهُمْ أَيْقَاظًۭا وَهُمْ رُقُودٌۭ ۚ وَنُقَلِّبُهُمْ ذَاتَ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَذَاتَ ٱلشِّمَالِ ۖ وَكَلْبُهُم بَٰسِطٌۭ ذِرَاعَيْهِ بِٱلْوَصِيدِ ۚ لَوِ ٱطَّلَعْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ لَوَلَّيْتَ مِنْهُمْ فِرَارًۭا وَلَمُلِئْتَ مِنْهُمْ رُعْبًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa tahsabuhum ayqaazanw wa hum ruqood; wa nuqallibuhum zaatal yameeni wa zaatash shimaali wa kalbuhum baasitun ziraa'ayhi bilwaseed; lawit tala'ta 'alaihim la wallaita minhum firaaranw wa lamuli'ta minhum rubaa
ayahs.translation: And you would think them awake, while they were asleep. And We turned them to the right and to the left, while their dog stretched his forelegs at the entrance. If you had looked at them, you would have turned from them in flight and been filled by them with terror.

ayahs.arabicText: وَكَذَٰلِكَ بَعَثْنَٰهُمْ لِيَتَسَآءَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ قَالَ قَآئِلٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍۢ ۚ قَالُوا۟ رَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا لَبِثْتُمْ فَٱبْعَثُوٓا۟ أَحَدَكُم بِوَرِقِكُمْ هَٰذِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ فَلْيَنظُرْ أَيُّهَآ أَزْكَىٰ طَعَامًۭا فَلْيَأْتِكُم بِرِزْقٍۢ مِّنْهُ وَلْيَتَلَطَّفْ وَلَا يُشْعِرَنَّ بِكُمْ أَحَدًا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa kazaalika ba'asnaahum liyatasaaa'aloo bainahum; qaala qaaa'ilum minhum kam labistum qaaloo labisnaa yawman aw ba'da yawm; qaaloo Rabbukum a'almu bimaa labistum fab'asooo ahadakum biwariqikum haazihee ilal madeenati falyanzur ayyuhaaa azkaa ta'aaman falyaatikum birizqim minhu walyatalattaf wa laa yush'iranna bikum ahadaa
ayahs.translation: And similarly, We awakened them that they might question one another. Said a speaker from among them, "How long have you remained [here]?" They said, "We have remained a day or part of a day." They said, "Your Lord is most knowing of how long you remained. So send one of you with this silver coin of yours to the city and let him look to which is the best of food and bring you provision from it and let him be cautious. And let no one be aware of you.

ayahs.arabicText: إِنَّهُمْ إِن يَظْهَرُوا۟ عَلَيْكُمْ يَرْجُمُوكُمْ أَوْ يُعِيدُوكُمْ فِى مِلَّتِهِمْ وَلَن تُفْلِحُوٓا۟ إِذًا أَبَدًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Innahum iny yazharoo 'alaikum yarjumookum aw yu'eedookum fee millatihim wa lan tuflihooo izan abadaa
ayahs.translation: Indeed, if they come to know of you, they will stone you or return you to their religion. And never would you succeed, then - ever."

ayahs.arabicText: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَعْثَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ لِيَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ وَأَنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَآ إِذْ يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ أَمْرَهُمْ ۖ فَقَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ عَلَيْهِم بُنْيَٰنًۭا ۖ رَّبُّهُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِهِمْ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ غَلَبُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرِهِمْ لَنَتَّخِذَنَّ عَلَيْهِم مَّسْجِدًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa kazaalika a'sarnaa 'alaihim liya'lamooo anna wa'dal laahi haqqunw wa annas Saa'ata laa raiba feehaa iz yatanaaza'oona bainahum amrahum faqaalub noo 'alaihim bunyaanaa; Rabbuhum a'lamu bihim; qaalal lazeena ghalaboo 'alaaa amrihim lanat takhizanna 'alaihim masjidaa
ayahs.translation: And similarly, We caused them to be found that they [who found them] would know that the promise of Allah is truth and that of the Hour there is no doubt. [That was] when they disputed among themselves about their affair and [then] said, "Construct over them a structure. Their Lord is most knowing about them." Said those who prevailed in the matter, "We will surely take [for ourselves] over them a masjid."

ayahs.arabicText: سَيَقُولُونَ ثَلَٰثَةٌۭ رَّابِعُهُمْ كَلْبُهُمْ وَيَقُولُونَ خَمْسَةٌۭ سَادِسُهُمْ كَلْبُهُمْ رَجْمًۢا بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۖ وَيَقُولُونَ سَبْعَةٌۭ وَثَامِنُهُمْ كَلْبُهُمْ ۚ قُل رَّبِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ بِعِدَّتِهِم مَّا يَعْلَمُهُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلٌۭ ۗ فَلَا تُمَارِ فِيهِمْ إِلَّا مِرَآءًۭ ظَٰهِرًۭا وَلَا تَسْتَفْتِ فِيهِم مِّنْهُمْ أَحَدًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Sa yaqooloona salaasatur raabi'uhum kalbuhum wa yaqooloona khamsatun saadisuhum kalbuhum rajmam bilghaib; wa yaqooloona sab'atunw wa saaminuhum kalbuhum; qur Rabbeee a'lamu bi'iddatihim maa ya'lamuhum illaa qaleel; falaa tumaari feehim illaa miraaa'an zaahiranw wa laa tastafti feehim minhum ahadaa
ayahs.translation: They will say there were three, the fourth of them being their dog; and they will say there were five, the sixth of them being their dog - guessing at the unseen; and they will say there were seven, and the eighth of them was their dog. Say, [O Muhammad], "My Lord is most knowing of their number. None knows them except a few. So do not argue about them except with an obvious argument and do not inquire about them among [the speculators] from anyone."

ayahs.arabicText: وَلَا تَقُولَنَّ لِشَا۟ىْءٍ إِنِّى فَاعِلٌۭ ذَٰلِكَ غَدًا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa laa taqoolanna lishai'in innee faa'ilun zaalika ghadaa
ayahs.translation: And never say of anything, "Indeed, I will do that tomorrow,"

ayahs.arabicText: إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَٱذْكُر رَّبَّكَ إِذَا نَسِيتَ وَقُلْ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَهْدِيَنِ رَبِّى لِأَقْرَبَ مِنْ هَٰذَا رَشَدًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Illaaa any yashaaa'al laah; wazkur Rabbaka izaa naseeta wa qul 'asaaa any yahdiyani Rabbee li aqraba min haazaa rashadaa
ayahs.translation: Except [when adding], "If Allah wills." And remember your Lord when you forget [it] and say, "Perhaps my Lord will guide me to what is nearer than this to right conduct."

ayahs.arabicText: وَلَبِثُوا۟ فِى كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَٰثَ مِا۟ئَةٍۢ سِنِينَ وَٱزْدَادُوا۟ تِسْعًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa labisoo fee kahfihim salaasa mi'atin sineena wazdaadoo tis'aa
ayahs.translation: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine.

ayahs.arabicText: قُلِ ٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا لَبِثُوا۟ ۖ لَهُۥ غَيْبُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ أَبْصِرْ بِهِۦ وَأَسْمِعْ ۚ مَا لَهُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ مِن وَلِىٍّۢ وَلَا يُشْرِكُ فِى حُكْمِهِۦٓ أَحَدًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Qulil laahu a'lamu bimaa labisoo lahoo ghaibus samaawaati wal ardi absir bihee wa asmi'; maa lahum min doonihee minw waliyyinw wa laa yushriku fee hukmihee ahadaa
ayahs.translation: Say, "Allah is most knowing of how long they remained. He has [knowledge of] the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. How Seeing is He and how Hearing! They have not besides Him any protector, and He shares not His legislation with anyone."

ayahs.arabicText: وَٱتْلُ مَآ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ مِن كِتَابِ رَبِّكَ ۖ لَا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَٰتِهِۦ وَلَن تَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَدًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Watlu maaa oohiya ilaika min Kitaabi Rabbika laa mubaddila li Kalimaatihee wa lan tajida min doonihee multahadaa
ayahs.translation: And recite, [O Muhammad], what has been revealed to you of the Book of your Lord. There is no changer of His words, and never will you find in other than Him a refuge.

ayahs.arabicText: وَٱصْبِرْ نَفْسَكَ مَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَدَوٰةِ وَٱلْعَشِىِّ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَهُۥ ۖ وَلَا تَعْدُ عَيْنَاكَ عَنْهُمْ تُرِيدُ زِينَةَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَا تُطِعْ مَنْ أَغْفَلْنَا قَلْبَهُۥ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ وَكَانَ أَمْرُهُۥ فُرُطًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wasbir nafsaka ma'al lazeena yad'oona Rabbahum bilghadaati wal'ashiyyi yureedoona Wajhahoo wa laa ta'du 'aynaaka 'anhum tureedu zeenatal hayaatid dunyaa wa laa tuti' man aghfalnaa qalbahoo 'an zikrinaa wattaba'a hawaahu wa kaana amruhoo furutaa
ayahs.translation: And keep yourself patient [by being] with those who call upon their Lord in the morning and the evening, seeking His countenance. And let not your eyes pass beyond them, desiring adornments of the worldly life, and do not obey one whose heart We have made heedless of Our remembrance and who follows his desire and whose affair is ever [in] neglect.

ayahs.arabicText: وَقُلِ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ فَلْيُؤْمِن وَمَن شَآءَ فَلْيَكْفُرْ ۚ إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ نَارًا أَحَاطَ بِهِمْ سُرَادِقُهَا ۚ وَإِن يَسْتَغِيثُوا۟ يُغَاثُوا۟ بِمَآءٍۢ كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَشْوِى ٱلْوُجُوهَ ۚ بِئْسَ ٱلشَّرَابُ وَسَآءَتْ مُرْتَفَقًا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa qulil haqqu mir Rabbikum faman shaaa'a falyu minw wa man shaaa'a falyakfur; innaaa a'tadnaa lizzaalimeena Naaran ahaata bihim suraadiquhaa; wa iny yastagheesoo yaghaasoo bimaaa'in kalmuhli yashwil wujooh' bi'sash-sharaab; wa saaa'at murtafaqaa
ayahs.translation: And say, "The truth is from your Lord, so whoever wills - let him believe; and whoever wills - let him disbelieve." Indeed, We have prepared for the wrongdoers a fire whose walls will surround them. And if they call for relief, they will be relieved with water like murky oil, which scalds [their] faces. Wretched is the drink, and evil is the resting place.

ayahs.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ إِنَّا لَا نُضِيعُ أَجْرَ مَنْ أَحْسَنَ عَمَلًا
ayahs.transliteration: Innal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati innaa laa nudee'u ajra man ahsana 'amalaa
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - indeed, We will not allow to be lost the reward of any who did well in deeds.

ayahs.arabicText: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهِمُ ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍۢ وَيَلْبَسُونَ ثِيَابًا خُضْرًۭا مِّن سُندُسٍۢ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍۢ مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۚ نِعْمَ ٱلثَّوَابُ وَحَسُنَتْ مُرْتَفَقًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Ulaaa'ika lahum Jannaatu 'Adnin tajree min tahtihimul anhaaru yuhallawna feehaa min asaawira min zahabinw wa yalbasoona siyaaban khudram min sundusinw wa istabraqim muttaki'eena feehaa 'alal araaa'ik; ni'mas sawaab; wa hasunat murtafaqaa
ayahs.translation: Those will have gardens of perpetual residence; beneath them rivers will flow. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and will wear green garments of fine silk and brocade, reclining therein on adorned couches. Excellent is the reward, and good is the resting place.

ayahs.arabicText: ۞ وَٱضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلًۭا رَّجُلَيْنِ جَعَلْنَا لِأَحَدِهِمَا جَنَّتَيْنِ مِنْ أَعْنَٰبٍۢ وَحَفَفْنَٰهُمَا بِنَخْلٍۢ وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُمَا زَرْعًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wadrib lahum masalar rajulaini ja'alnaa li ahadihimaa jannataini min a'naabinw wa hafafnaahumaa binakhilinw wa ja'alnaa bainahumaa zar'aa
ayahs.translation: And present to them an example of two men: We granted to one of them two gardens of grapevines, and We bordered them with palm trees and placed between them [fields of] crops.

ayahs.arabicText: كِلْتَا ٱلْجَنَّتَيْنِ ءَاتَتْ أُكُلَهَا وَلَمْ تَظْلِم مِّنْهُ شَيْـًۭٔا ۚ وَفَجَّرْنَا خِلَٰلَهُمَا نَهَرًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Kiltal jannataini aatat ukulahaa wa lam tazlim minhu shai'anw wa fajjarnaa khi laalahumaa naharaa
ayahs.translation: Each of the two gardens produced its fruit and did not fall short thereof in anything. And We caused to gush forth within them a river.

ayahs.arabicText: وَكَانَ لَهُۥ ثَمَرٌۭ فَقَالَ لِصَٰحِبِهِۦ وَهُوَ يُحَاوِرُهُۥٓ أَنَا۠ أَكْثَرُ مِنكَ مَالًۭا وَأَعَزُّ نَفَرًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa kaana lahoo samarun faqaala lisaahibihee wa huwa yuhaawiruhoo ana aksaru minka maalanw wa a'azzu nafaraa
ayahs.translation: And he had fruit, so he said to his companion while he was conversing with him, "I am greater than you in wealth and mightier in [numbers of] men."

ayahs.arabicText: وَدَخَلَ جَنَّتَهُۥ وَهُوَ ظَالِمٌۭ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ قَالَ مَآ أَظُنُّ أَن تَبِيدَ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أَبَدًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa dakhala jannatahoo wa huwa zaalimul linafsihee qaala maaa azunnu an tabeeda haaziheee abadaa
ayahs.translation: And he entered his garden while he was unjust to himself. He said, "I do not think that this will perish - ever.

ayahs.arabicText: وَمَآ أَظُنُّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ قَآئِمَةًۭ وَلَئِن رُّدِدتُّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّى لَأَجِدَنَّ خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهَا مُنقَلَبًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maaa azunnus Saa'ata qaaa'imatanw wa la'ir rudittu ilaa Rabbee la ajidanna khairam minhaa munqalabaa
ayahs.translation: And I do not think the Hour will occur. And even if I should be brought back to my Lord, I will surely find better than this as a return."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ لَهُۥ صَاحِبُهُۥ وَهُوَ يُحَاوِرُهُۥٓ أَكَفَرْتَ بِٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ مِن تُرَابٍۢ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ ثُمَّ سَوَّىٰكَ رَجُلًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala lahoo saahibuhoo wa huwa yuhaawiruhooo akafarta billazee khalaqaka min turaabin summa min nutfatin summa sawwaaka rajulaa
ayahs.translation: His companion said to him while he was conversing with him, "Have you disbelieved in He who created you from dust and then from a sperm-drop and then proportioned you [as] a man?

ayahs.arabicText: لَّٰكِنَّا۠ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ رَبِّى وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِرَبِّىٓ أَحَدًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Laakinaa Huwal laahu Rabbee wa laa ushriku bi Rabbeee ahadaa
ayahs.translation: But as for me, He is Allah, my Lord, and I do not associate with my Lord anyone.

ayahs.arabicText: وَلَوْلَآ إِذْ دَخَلْتَ جَنَّتَكَ قُلْتَ مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِٱللَّهِ ۚ إِن تَرَنِ أَنَا۠ أَقَلَّ مِنكَ مَالًۭا وَوَلَدًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa law laaa iz dakhalta jannataka qulta maa shaaa'al laahu laa quwwata illaa billaah; in tarani ana aqalla minka maalanw wa waladaa
ayahs.translation: And why did you, when you entered your garden, not say, 'What Allah willed [has occurred]; there is no power except in Allah '? Although you see me less than you in wealth and children,

ayahs.arabicText: فَعَسَىٰ رَبِّىٓ أَن يُؤْتِيَنِ خَيْرًۭا مِّن جَنَّتِكَ وَيُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهَا حُسْبَانًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَتُصْبِحَ صَعِيدًۭا زَلَقًا
ayahs.transliteration: Fa'asaa Rabeee any yu'tiyani khairam min jannatika wa yursila 'alaihaa husbaanam minas samaaa'i fatusbiha sa'eedan zalaqaa
ayahs.translation: It may be that my Lord will give me [something] better than your garden and will send upon it a calamity from the sky, and it will become a smooth, dusty ground,

ayahs.arabicText: أَوْ يُصْبِحَ مَآؤُهَا غَوْرًۭا فَلَن تَسْتَطِيعَ لَهُۥ طَلَبًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Aw yusbiha maaa'uhaaa ghawran falan tastatee'a lahoo talabaa
ayahs.translation: Or its water will become sunken [into the earth], so you would never be able to seek it."

ayahs.arabicText: وَأُحِيطَ بِثَمَرِهِۦ فَأَصْبَحَ يُقَلِّبُ كَفَّيْهِ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَنفَقَ فِيهَا وَهِىَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا وَيَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُشْرِكْ بِرَبِّىٓ أَحَدًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa uheeta bisamarihee faasbaha yuqallibu kaffaihi 'alaa maaa anfaqa feehaa wa hiya khaawiyatun 'alaa 'urooshihaa wa yaqoolu yaalaitanee lam ushrik bi Rabbeee ahadaa
ayahs.translation: And his fruits were encompassed [by ruin], so he began to turn his hands about [in dismay] over what he had spent on it, while it had collapsed upon its trellises, and said, "Oh, I wish I had not associated with my Lord anyone."

ayahs.arabicText: وَلَمْ تَكُن لَّهُۥ فِئَةٌۭ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مُنتَصِرًا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa lam takul lahoo fi'atuny yansuroonahoo min doonil laahi wa maa kaana muntasiraa
ayahs.translation: And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allah, nor could he defend himself.

ayahs.arabicText: هُنَالِكَ ٱلْوَلَٰيَةُ لِلَّهِ ٱلْحَقِّ ۚ هُوَ خَيْرٌۭ ثَوَابًۭا وَخَيْرٌ عُقْبًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Hunaalikal walaayatu lillaahil haqq; huwa khairun sawaabanw wa khairun 'uqbaa
ayahs.translation: There the authority is [completely] for Allah, the Truth. He is best in reward and best in outcome.
